title: At held_proposals.stage enforce, admit a protected or pipeline-kind item to a lane as a held proposal (ADR-0157 H5)
summary: The census and the lane menu admit a console_kind or console_protected item (not a route:console item) as a held proposal at enforce. The role guard and the ship control-plane check allow the protected files that the claimed held item declares, and only those. At shadow the census only counts what it would admit.
acceptance: At shadow no protected item reaches a lane, and evolve wave supply prints the count it would admit.
At enforce a lane that claimed a held item can change only the protected files that the item declares; any other protected file is still refused.
Each such ship is held by held-proposal-gate.
notes: Held proposal: it relaxes the role guard and the ship control-plane check, which are guards. It must land only after the hold and the audit dispatch are proven at shadow.
